test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

a) Some suitcases are pouches.

b) Some bags are purses.

c) All pouches are purses.

Conclusions:

I. Some suitcases are purses.

II. Some purses are bags.

III. All purses are pouches.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f4a7e811a9093747faa6fa5ee97f355cefc0966f6373de0ca0a29a52b30c8ea.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some suitcases are purses. → True (As, Some suitcases are pouches and All pouches are purses → Some suitcases are purses)

II. Some purses are bags. → True (As, Some bags are purses → Some purses are bags)

III. All purses are pouches. → False (As, All pouches are purses → Some purses are pouches)

Hence, **only conclusions I and II follow**.
